reasons.quote: والأعمش، كلهم سمعوا زيد بن وهب، عن أبي ذر

note: Three co-transmitters, the last an unnamed group, stand at the first level and all say «قالوا» from Abu Usama.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters, the last an unnamed group, stand at the first level and all say «قالوا» from Abu Usama.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كريب، وعبد بن حميد، وغير، واحد، قالوا أخبرنا أبو أسامة

reasons.claim: The chain runs on through al-Hasan and Abu Sabra to Farwa, who tells of coming to the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو سبرة النخعي، عن فروة بن مسيك المرادي، قال أتيت النبي

reasons.claim: The Ibn Abbas line has no transmitters of its own and is a remark, not a route.
reasons.quote: وروي هذا عن ابن عباس عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: The report relays only Hafs's habit of how he introduced Ja'far, so the words relayed are Hafs's own and he is the last link.

reasons.claim: The report relays only Hafs's habit of how he introduced Ja'far, so the words relayed are Hafs's own and he is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن حفص بن غياث، أنه كان إذا حدثنا عن جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام)، قال: حدثني خير الجعافر

reasons.claim: Ja'far is only named and described inside the account of Hafs's habit; he says nothing in this report, so he is not a link (ruling 4).
reasons.quote: حدثني خير الجعافر جعفر بن محمد

reasons.claim: The five transmitters before Hafs are written in order, each with «حدثنا».
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن أحمد السناني، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

levels.surface: محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: The report is Hafs's habit of introducing Ja'far; Ja'far speaks no words here and is not a link.

note: One chain of four links, the second written only as «أبي».

reasons.claim: One chain of four links, the second written only as «أبي».
reasons.quote: وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن حميد بن نافع

reasons.claim: «جميعا» joins the two reports carried, not routes, and «نحو حديث محمد بن جعفر» is a bare comparison remark.
reasons.quote: بالحديثين جميعا

note: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the saying alone.

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the saying alone.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ: «أَنَّ مَنْ قَصَدَ

note: One chain of five links ends at Jabir, whose words about Bilal are the report.

reasons.claim: One chain of five links ends at Jabir, whose words about Bilal are the report.
reasons.quote: عن سماك بن حرب، عن جابر بن سمرة، قال كان بلال

note: Four co-transmitters from Ibn Idris all pass on from al-Maqburi.

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters from Ibn Idris all pass on from al-Maqburi.
reasons.quote: عن عبيد الله، وابن، جريج وابن إسحاق ومالك بن أنس عن المقبري

reasons.claim: Ibn Umar is asked and answers, so he is the last link (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: قال قلت لابن عمر

note: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter.

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter.
reasons.quote: وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ

note: Ibn Abi Umayr narrates from Aban and an unnamed other, both from the Imam, who speaks.

reasons.claim: Ibn Abi Umayr narrates from Aban and an unnamed other, both from the Imam, who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبَانٍ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

note: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the ruling alone.

reasons.claim: The passive «رُوِيَ» names no transmitter; the text is the ruling alone.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ: «فِي اَلرَّجُلِ

note: Al-Sakuni narrates by his own unstated isnad to the Prophet, who ends the chain and is not a link.

reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni narrates by his own unstated isnad to the Prophet, who ends the chain and is not a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: «بإسناده» is a gap rather than a pointer to an earlier report, but its kind changes no route.
reasons.quote: بإسناده

note: Three taḥwīl branches open the chain, the third with two co-transmitters joined by «قالا».

reasons.claim: Three taḥwīl branches open the chain, the third with two co-transmitters joined by «قالا».
reasons.quote: وحدثني زهير بن حرب، وابن المثنى، قالا حدثنا يحيى

reasons.claim: «كلهم عن» makes the rest a tail shared by every branch.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: «أبي» in the second branch is Ibn Numayr's unnamed father, a relation link.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا ابن نمير، حدثنا أبي

note: No transmitter is written; the Imam is the one asked and answering, so he is the single link (ruling 2).

reasons.claim: No transmitter is written; the Imam is the one asked and answering, so he is the single link (ruling 2).
reasons.quote: وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ

note: A single chain ends at Aisha, whose own words follow; the stored chain wrongly stops at Urwa.

reasons.claim: A single chain ends at Aisha, whose own words follow; the stored chain wrongly stops at Urwa.
reasons.quote: عن عروة، أن عائشة، رضى الله عنها أخبرته

note: «هو ابن سعيد» is a gloss on Ishaq, not a link; the chain ends at Ibn Umar, who speaks.

reasons.claim: «هو ابن سعيد» is a gloss on Ishaq, not a link; the chain ends at Ibn Umar, who speaks.
reasons.quote: حدثنا إسحاق  هو ابن سعيد  عن سعيد، عن ابن عمر

note: Four co-transmitters meet at Sufyan through «قالوا».

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters meet at Sufyan through «قالوا».
reasons.quote: ومحمود بن غيلان، قالوا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة

reasons.claim: Salim's unnamed father is the last link and speaks; those seen walking are not links.
reasons.quote: عن سالم، عن أبيه، قال رأيت النبي

note: After Abu Ubayd the text writes only unnamed connected chains, an unnamed link.

reasons.claim: After Abu Ubayd the text writes only unnamed connected chains, an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبيد القاسم بن سلام بأسانيد متصلة إلى النبي

reasons.claim: The stored chain takes words of the explanation as names.
reasons.quote: المحاقلة

note: Two co-transmitters meet at Zuhayr with «جميعا»; the dashed remark only states Ibn Yunus's wording and adds no route.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters meet at Zuhayr with «جميعا»; the dashed remark only states Ibn Yunus's wording and adds no route.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن زهير، - قال ابن يونس حدثنا زهير، -

reasons.claim: Abu al-Zubayr's later question runs along the same route and adds no link.
reasons.quote: قال أبو الزبير فسألت سعيدا

note: One chain ends at Ibn Mughaffal, who speaks; «شك كهمس» is a note on the wording.

reasons.claim: One chain ends at Ibn Mughaffal, who speaks; «شك كهمس» is a note on the wording.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الله بن مغفل، أنه رأى رجلا يخذف فقال

note: The father and «جماعة مشايخي» are co-transmitters at the first level.

reasons.claim: The father and «جماعة مشايخي» are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي

reasons.claim: Abu Abdillah narrates an event in which Amir al-Mu'minin speaks; under ruling 9 the speaker is the last link, which both readers omit.
reasons.quote: قَالَ مَرَّ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ (ع) بِكَرْبَلَاءَ

reasons.claim: The relayed words are Amir al-Mu'minin's.
reasons.quote: ثُمَّ قَالَ هَذَا مُنَاخُ رِكَابِهِمْ

levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن عبيد الله

notes: Amir al-Mu'minin speaks inside the Imam's narrated story: last link (ruling 9).

note: One chain read to Malik ends at Ibn Umar; «واللفظ له» is a note, and the stored chain stops too early.

reasons.claim: One chain read to Malik ends at Ibn Umar; «واللفظ له» is a note, and the stored chain stops too early.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع عن ابن عمر

note: The text writes one chain of four links from Ahmad b. Yunus to Jabir.

reasons.claim: The text writes one chain of four links from Ahmad b. Yunus to Jabir.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس، حدثنا زهير، حدثنا أبو الزبير، عن جابر

reasons.claim: The text ends at «ح» with no second branch written, so only one route can be read.
reasons.quote: عن جابر، ح

note: The report is only a saying with no transmitter before it; the stored 'chain' is the saying's own words.

reasons.claim: The report is only a saying with no transmitter before it; the stored 'chain' is the saying's own words.
reasons.quote: اَلْعَائِدُ فِي هِبَتِهِ كَالْعَائِدِ فِي قَيْئِهِ

note: The chain runs through five named transmitters to Muhammad b. al-Mu'alla.

reasons.claim: The chain runs through five named transmitters to Muhammad b. al-Mu'alla.
reasons.quote: حدثني موسى بن جعفر البغدادي، عن محمد بن المعلي

reasons.claim: «عمن أخبره» is a gap and is rightly an unnamed link, separate from the name before it.
reasons.quote: عن محمد بن المعلي، عمن أخبره، عن أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: The Imam stands inside the chain after «عن» and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

note: «غير مرة» is a note on Sufyan's narrating, not a name, so the stored «سفيان غير» is defective.

reasons.claim: «غير مرة» is a note on Sufyan's narrating, not a name, so the stored «سفيان غير» is defective.
reasons.quote: غير مرة

reasons.claim: The chain continues to Umar, whose words the report relays.
reasons.quote: عن عمرو، عن الزهري، عن مالك بن أوس بن الحدثان، عن عمر

note: The first branch reaches Ibn Ajlan before «ح».

reasons.claim: The first branch reaches Ibn Ajlan before «ح».
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد الله بن رجاء المكي، عن ابن عجلان، ح

reasons.claim: The second branch has two co-transmitters from Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba, meeting at Muhammad b. Ajlan.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، وأبو خالد الأحمر عن محمد بن عجلان

reasons.claim: Abu Salama tells of Aisha speaking, so she is the last link (narrated encounter), which the stored chain omits.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سلمة، قال رأت عائشة عبد الرحمن وهو يتوضأ فقالت

note: Amr b. Talha is a link between Sulayman and Asbat; the stored chain drops him.

reasons.claim: Amr b. Talha is a link between Sulayman and Asbat; the stored chain drops him.
reasons.quote: أن عمرو بن طلحة، حدثهم قال حدثنا أسباط

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Ibn Abbas; the persons in the story are not links.
reasons.quote: عن سماك، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، في قصة

note: Four co-transmitters stand at the first level, giving four routes.

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters stand at the first level, giving four routes.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ أَخِي وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ

reasons.claim: «أبيه سدير» is one link, Sadir, after Hanan.
reasons.quote: عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَدِيرٍ

reasons.claim: The Imam named after the chain speaks and is the last link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع)

note: Three co-transmitters at the first level all take from Abu Awana.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at the first level all take from Abu Awana.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وقتيبة بن سعيد، ومحمد بن عبيد الغبري

reasons.claim: «قال يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخران» only distinguishes verbs and adds no name.
reasons.quote: قال يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو عوانة

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Anas, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن قتادة، عن أنس، قال قال رسول الله

note: «ح» opens a second branch from Muhammad b. Rumh, both meeting at al-Layth.

reasons.claim: «ح» opens a second branch from Muhammad b. Rumh, both meeting at al-Layth.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ليث، ح وحدثناه محمد بن رمح، أخبرنا الليث

reasons.claim: Two Companions are co-transmitters at the last level, so the stored chain's lack of a Qutayba-to-Zayd route is a defect.
reasons.quote: عن أبي هريرة، وزيد بن خالد، الجهني أنهما قالا

note: The passive «قد روي» names no transmitter, so there is no isnad; the stored 'chain' is words of the saying.

reasons.claim: The passive «قد روي» names no transmitter, so there is no isnad; the stored 'chain' is words of the saying.
reasons.quote: وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ

note: The chain runs Musaddad, Yahya, Hisham, Hafsa to Umm Atiyya, who relays the Prophet's words; both readers write exactly this.

reasons.claim: The chain runs Musaddad, Yahya, Hisham, Hafsa to Umm Atiyya, who relays the Prophet's words; both readers write exactly this.
reasons.quote: قال حدثتنا حفصة، عن أم عطية

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops at Hisham and omits the two last links the text writes.
reasons.quote: هشام بن حسان

note: Three co-transmitters at one level are joined by «جميعا» at Ahmad, as both readers write.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at one level are joined by «جميعا» at Ahmad, as both readers write.
reasons.quote: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَحْمَدَ

reasons.claim: «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter beside Ali b. al-Hakam.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ وَ غَيْرِهِ

reasons.claim: Ali relays the Prophet's words and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ (ع) قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ

note: The father and a group of shaykhs are co-transmitters at the first level.

reasons.claim: The father and a group of shaykhs are co-transmitters at the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله) وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) قَالَ

note: Hisham asks Ibrahim and Ibrahim answers, so Ibrahim is the last link (ruling 3).

reasons.claim: Hisham asks Ibrahim and Ibrahim answers, so Ibrahim is the last link (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: قال سألت إبراهيم عن العصير، قال اشربه

note: Amr b. Sulaym is a link between Abu Bakr b. al-Munkadir and Abd al-Rahman; the stored chain drops him.

reasons.claim: Amr b. Sulaym is a link between Abu Bakr b. al-Munkadir and Abd al-Rahman; the stored chain drops him.
reasons.quote: أن عمرو بن سليم، أخبره عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد

reasons.claim: The bare relation «أبيه» relays the Prophet's words and is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبيه، عن رسول الله

note: The report is an explanatory sentence with no transmitter, and the stored chain holds that sentence as a name.

reasons.claim: The report is an explanatory sentence with no transmitter, and the stored chain holds that sentence as a name.
reasons.quote: وَ سُمِّيَ اَلْبَيْتُ اَلْعَتِيقَ

note: «رفعه إلى» marks an unnamed gap before the Imam, who is the last link.

reasons.claim: «رفعه إلى» marks an unnamed gap before the Imam, who is the last link.
reasons.quote: الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ الْمُخْتَارِ رَفَعَهُ إِلَی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ ع قَالَ

note: Abu Ja'far relays the words of Ali, so Ali is the last link; the readers differ only in his kind, which changes no route.

reasons.claim: Abu Ja'far relays the words of Ali, so Ali is the last link; the readers differ only in his kind, which changes no route.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ ع قَالَ قَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ

reasons.claim: The stored chain stops at Abu Ja'far and omits Ali.
reasons.quote: أبی جعفر ع

note: The chain runs from Bakr b. Khalaf through Yahya b. Sa'id and Mis'ar to an unnamed shaykh of Fahm.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Bakr b. Khalaf through Yahya b. Sa'id and Mis'ar to an unnamed shaykh of Fahm.
reasons.quote: حدثنا بكر بن خلف أبو بشر، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن مسعر، حدثني شيخ، من فهم

reasons.claim: The parenthetical guess about the shaykh's name is hedged and does not replace the unnamed link.
reasons.quote: قال وأظنه يسمى محمد بن عبد الله

reasons.claim: Abd Allah b. Ja'far is the last link hearing the Prophet, while Ibn al-Zubayr is only the listener in the scene.
reasons.quote: أنه سمع عبد الله بن جعفر يحدث ابن الزبير

note: Sama'ah is the asker and therefore a link, while the suffixed pronoun refers back to the Imam of the preceding reports.

reasons.claim: Sama'ah is the asker and therefore a link, while the suffixed pronoun refers back to the Imam of the preceding reports.
reasons.quote: وَ سَأَلَهُ سَمَاعَةُ

reasons.claim: The nearest preceding report with a written chain ends at Abu Abd Allah, supplying the inherited Imam link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

note: Three tahwil branches (with Ishaq b. Ibrahim and Abd b. Humayd as co-transmitters in the first) converge at al-Zuhri with a shared back reference.

reasons.claim: Three tahwil branches (with Ishaq b. Ibrahim and Abd b. Humayd as co-transmitters in the first) converge at al-Zuhri with a shared back reference.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: The closing statements comparing the wordings of al-Awza'i, Ibn Jurayj, al-Layth, and Ma'mar are variant remarks rather than routes.
reasons.quote: أما الأوزاعي وابن جريج ففي حديثهما قال أسلمت لله

note: Two tahwil branches (with three co-transmitters under Muhammad b. Bashshar and one under Ishaq b. Ibrahim) meet at Ibn Jurayj.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches (with three co-transmitters under Muhammad b. Bashshar and one under Ishaq b. Ibrahim) meet at Ibn Jurayj.
reasons.quote: عن ابن جريج، ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، - واللفظ له - أخبرنا محمد بن، بكر أخبرنا ابن جريج

reasons.claim: The shared tail runs from Abu al-Zubayr through co-transmitters Tawus and Ikrimah to Ibn Abbas, while Duba'ah is the subject of the report rather than a link.
reasons.quote: أخبرني أبو الزبير، أنه سمع طاوسا، وعكرمة، مولى ابن عباس عن ابن عباس

note: The single chain runs from the compiler's father through Sa'd b. Abd Allah, Abbad b. Sulayman, and Sudayr al-Sayrafi to Abu Abd Allah.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from the compiler's father through Sa'd b. Abd Allah, Abbad b. Sulayman, and Sudayr al-Sayrafi to Abu Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: أبي رحمة الله، قال: حدّثني سعد بن عبد الله، عن عباد بن سليمان، عن سدير الصيرفي، عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام

reasons.claim: Abu Basir and Maysarah are merely present in the gathering and are not links.
reasons.quote: وعنده أبو بصير، وميسرة وعدّة من جلسائه

note: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Bashshar through Abd al-Wahhab, Ayyub, and Muhammad, who asks Anas b. Malik.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Bashshar through Abd al-Wahhab, Ayyub, and Muhammad, who asks Anas b. Malik.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا عبد الوهاب، حدثنا أيوب، عن محمد، قال سألت أنس بن مالك

reasons.claim: Anas b. Malik answers by reporting the Prophet's practice, so Anas is the last link.
reasons.quote: فقال قنت رسول الله

note: Ahmad b. Isa and Harmalah b. Yahya are co-transmitters from Ibn Wahb, followed by Amr b. al-Harith and Bukayr b. Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj.

reasons.claim: Ahmad b. Isa and Harmalah b. Yahya are co-transmitters from Ibn Wahb, followed by Amr b. al-Harith and Bukayr b. Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن عيسى، وحرملة بن يحيى المصريان، قالا حدثنا ابن وهب، عن عمرو بن الحارث، عن بكير بن عبد الله بن الأشج

reasons.claim: Abu al-Sa'ib transmitted to Bukayr what he heard from Abu Hurayrah, who ends the chain at the Prophet.
reasons.quote: أن أبا السائب، مولى هشام بن زهرة حدثه أنه، سمع أبا هريرة

reasons.quote: أن عمر بن الخطاب، - رضى الله عنه - حمل على فرس في سبيل الله

reasons.quote: وساق الحديث بمثل حديث عمرو بن الحارث

note: Ikrima and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib are co-transmitters from Ibn Abbas, yielding two routes from Qatada.

reasons.claim: Ikrima and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib are co-transmitters from Ibn Abbas, yielding two routes from Qatada.
reasons.quote: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، حدثنا أبان، حدثنا قتادة، عن عكرمة، وسعيد بن المسيب، عن ابن عباس

note: The chain runs through Abd al-Aziz ibn Yahya Abu al-Asbagh, Muhammad (excluding the editor's gloss), Muhammad ibn Ishaq, al-Zuhri, a back reference to his isnad, and an unnamed man of Muzayna.

reasons.claim: The chain runs through Abd al-Aziz ibn Yahya Abu al-Asbagh, Muhammad (excluding the editor's gloss), Muhammad ibn Ishaq, al-Zuhri, a back reference to his isnad, and an unnamed man of Muzayna.

reasons.claim: In the narrated encounter, Umar b. al-Khattab speaks directly, so under ruling 9 he is the last link after Malik b. Aws b. al-Hadathan.
reasons.quote: قال أرسل إلى عمر بن الخطاب فقال إنه قد حضر أهل أبيات من قومك

notes: Umar b. al-Khattab speaks in the encounter narrated by Malik b. Aws b. al-Hadathan, so he is the last link (ruling 9).

note: Two tahwil branches meet at al-Zuhri and share the tail through co-transmitters Abd Allah and al-Hasan, their father, and Ali.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches meet at al-Zuhri and share the tail through co-transmitters Abd Allah and al-Hasan, their father, and Ali.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا عبد الوهاب الثقفي، عن يحيى بن سعيد الأنصاري، عن مالك بن أنس، عن الزهري، ح وحدثنا ابن أبي عمر، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن عبد الله، والحسن، ابنى محمد بن علي عن أبيهما، عن علي

note: The isnad runs from Yahya ibn Sulayman through Ibn Wahb, Umar, and Salim to Abd Allah ibn Umar, who relays the report.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Yahya ibn Sulayman through Ibn Wahb, Umar, and Salim to Abd Allah ibn Umar, who relays the report.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن سليمان، قال حدثني ابن وهب، قال حدثني عمر، أن سالما، حدثه عن عبد الله بن عمر،

note: The isnad runs from Abd Allah ibn Yusuf through al-Layth, Uqayl, Ibn Shihab, and Abu Salama to Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who heard the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Abd Allah ibn Yusuf through al-Layth, Uqayl, Ibn Shihab, and Abu Salama to Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who heard the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف، حدثنا الليث، عن عقيل، قال ابن شهاب سمعت أبا سلمة، قال أخبرني جابر بن عبد الله، أنه سمع رسول الله

reasons.claim: Abu Salama's later remark explaining a word inside the matn is commentary and does not add a link.
reasons.quote: قال أبو سلمة والرجز الأوثان

note: The isnad runs from the compiler's father through Sa'd ibn Abd Allah, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Asbahani, Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari, and Sufyan Uyna to Abu Abd Allah named as the speaker.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from the compiler's father through Sa'd ibn Abd Allah, al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Asbahani, Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari, and Sufyan Uyna to Abu Abd Allah named as the speaker.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي - رحمه الله - قال: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله، عن القاسم بن محمد الأصبهاني، عن سليمان بن داود المنقري، عن سفيان عينة، قال: سمعت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام يقول:

note: The isnad runs from Ibn al-Muthanna through Abu Dawud, Shu'ba, and Abu Hamza to Anas ibn Malik, with Shu'ba's parenthetical gloss on Abu Hamza's name excluded.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Ibn al-Muthanna through Abu Dawud, Shu'ba, and Abu Hamza to Anas ibn Malik, with Shu'ba's parenthetical gloss on Abu Hamza's name excluded.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا ابن المثنى، حدثنا أبو داود، حدثنا شعبة، عن أبي حمزة، - قال شعبة واسمه عبد الرحمن بن أبي عبد الله - عن أنس بن مالك،

note: The isnad runs from Ibn Abi Umar through Marwan (excluding the gloss) and Humayd to Anas, who is asked and answers.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Ibn Abi Umar through Marwan (excluding the gloss) and Humayd to Anas, who is asked and answers.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن أبي عمر، حدثنا مروان، - يعني الفزاري - عن حميد، قال سئل أنس عن كسب الحجام،

note: Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan and Yusuf ibn Sa'id are co-transmitters who both report from Hajjaj, from Ibn Jurayj, who asked Ata.

reasons.claim: Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan and Yusuf ibn Sa'id are co-transmitters who both report from Hajjaj, from Ibn Jurayj, who asked Ata.
reasons.quote: أخبرني إبراهيم بن الحسن، ويوسف بن سعيد، - واللفظ له - قالا حدثنا حجاج، عن ابن جريج، قال قلت لعطاء

reasons.claim: Ata answers by quoting Ibn Abbas, making Ata and Ibn Abbas the final links.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت ابن عباس يقول

note: Waki', Abu Mu'awiya, and Hushaym are three co-transmitters between Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shayba and al-A'mash, continuing through Mundhir ibn Ya'la (excluding the kunya gloss) and Ibn al-Hanafiyya to Ali.

reasons.claim: Waki', Abu Mu'awiya, and Hushaym are three co-transmitters between Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shayba and al-A'mash, continuing through Mundhir ibn Ya'la (excluding the kunya gloss) and Ibn al-Hanafiyya to Ali.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، وأبو معاوية وهشيم عن الأعمش، عن منذر بن يعلى، - ويكنى أبا يعلى - عن ابن الحنفية، عن علي،

note: The isnad runs from Muhammad ibn Sadran through al-Mu'tamir, Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, Mujalid ibn Sa'id, and Amir to Fatima bint Qays.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Muhammad ibn Sadran through al-Mu'tamir, Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, Mujalid ibn Sa'id, and Amir to Fatima bint Qays.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن صدران، حدثنا المعتمر، حدثنا إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن مجالد بن سعيد، عن عامر، قال حدثتني فاطمة بنت قيس،

reasons.claim: Abu Dawud's closing biographical remark about Ibn Sadran is commentary and not part of the chain.
reasons.quote: قال أبو داود وابن صدران بصري غرق في البحر مع ابن مسور لم يسلم منهم غيره

note: Abu al-Tahir, Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli, and Ahmad ibn Isa are three co-transmitters reporting from Ibn Wahb, Makhrama, his father, Irak ibn Malik, and Abu Hurayra.

reasons.claim: Abu al-Tahir, Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli, and Ahmad ibn Isa are three co-transmitters reporting from Ibn Wahb, Makhrama, his father, Irak ibn Malik, and Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: وحدثني أبو الطاهر، وهارون بن سعيد الأيلي، وأحمد بن عيسى، قالوا حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني مخرمة، عن أبيه، عن عراك بن مالك، قال سمعت أبا هريرة،

note: The isnad runs from Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli through Ibn Wahb, Usama, and Hafs ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Anas ibn Malik to Anas ibn Malik.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli through Ibn Wahb, Usama, and Hafs ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Anas ibn Malik to Anas ibn Malik.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا هارون بن سعيد الأيلي، حدثنا ابن وهب، حدثني أسامة، أن حفص بن، عبيد الله بن أنس بن مالك حدثه أنه، سمع أنس بن مالك،

note: The report has a single linear chain of five transmitters ending at Ibn Abbas, who relays the Prophet's action.

reasons.claim: The report has a single linear chain of five transmitters ending at Ibn Abbas, who relays the Prophet's action.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا قتيبة، قال حدثنا سفيان، عن عمرو، عن جابر بن زيد، عن ابن عباس، قال صليت مع النبي

note: The isnad splits at «ح» into two routes after al-Walid—through Ibn Namir (omitting the editor's gloss) and through al-Awza'i—both ending at Abd Allah ibn Abbas.

reasons.claim: The isnad splits at «ح» into two routes after al-Walid—through Ibn Namir (omitting the editor's gloss) and through al-Awza'i—both ending at Abd Allah ibn Abbas.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عمرو بن عثمان بن سعيد، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن ابن نمر، - وهو عبد الرحمن بن نمر - عن الزهري، عن كثير بن عباس، ح وأخبرني عمرو بن عثمان، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، عن الزهري، قال أخبرني كثير بن عباس، عن عبد الله بن عباس،

note: The chain runs linearly through four transmitters, omitting the editor's gloss on Humayd and ending at Hisham ibn Amir.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through four transmitters, omitting the editor's gloss on Humayd and ending at Hisham ibn Amir.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة القعنبي، أن سليمان بن المغيرة، حدثهم عن حميد، - يعني ابن هلال - عن هشام بن عامر،

note: Two co-transmitters via Abu Mu'awiyah and a second «ح» branch via Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Isa ibn Yunus meet at al-A'mash and end with the back-reference phrase.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters via Abu Mu'awiyah and a second «ح» branch via Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Isa ibn Yunus meet at al-A'mash and end with the back-reference phrase.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، ح وحدثنا إسحاق، بن إبراهيم أخبرنا عيسى بن يونس، كلاهما عن الأعمش، بإسناد عبد الله بن نمير

note: The chain runs through five transmitters to two co-transmitters, A'ishah and Umm Salamah, who jointly report the Prophet's command.

reasons.claim: The chain runs through five transmitters to two co-transmitters, A'ishah and Umm Salamah, who jointly report the Prophet's command.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا المفضل بن عبد الله، عن جابر، عن الشعبي، عن مسروق، عن عائشة، وأم سلمة قالتا

note: Two «ح» branches meet at «قالا حدثنا» and share the tail from Rashid Abu Muhammad al-Himmani down to Abu al-Darda'.

reasons.claim: Two «ح» branches meet at «قالا حدثنا» and share the tail from Rashid Abu Muhammad al-Himmani down to Abu al-Darda'.
reasons.quote: حدثنا الحسين بن الحسن المروزي، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، ح وحدثنا إبراهيم بن سعيد الجوهري، حدثنا عبد الوهاب بن عطاء، قالا حدثنا راشد أبو محمد الحماني، عن شهر بن حوشب، عن أم الدرداء، عن أبي الدرداء،

note: The text writes a single linear chain of seven transmitters, keeping Khalid ibn Abd Allah and Khalid as separate links as written.

reasons.claim: The text writes a single linear chain of seven transmitters, keeping Khalid ibn Abd Allah and Khalid as separate links as written.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا خالد بن عبد الله، عن خالد، عن أبي معشر، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن عبد الله،

note: The chain runs linearly through five transmitters, including the bracketed Companion Abu Hurayrah before the prophetic report.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through five transmitters, including the bracketed Companion Abu Hurayrah before the prophetic report.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا واصل بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا ابن فضيل، عن الأعمش، عن أبي حازم، ‏{‏ عن أبي هريرة، ‏}‏ قال نهى رسول الله

note: The chain runs from Musaddad through al-A'mash to Ibrahim as speaker (not the earlier place mention), then al-Aswad and A'ishah.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Musaddad through al-A'mash to Ibrahim as speaker (not the earlier place mention), then al-Aswad and A'ishah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا مسدد، حدثنا عبد الواحد، حدثنا الأعمش، قال تذاكرنا عند إبراهيم الرهن، والقبيل في السلف، فقال إبراهيم حدثنا الأسود عن عائشة

note: The chain runs linearly through six links, omitting the editor's gloss on Muhammad and ending at the bare relation «أبيه».

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through six links, omitting the editor's gloss on Muhammad and ending at the bare relation «أبيه».
reasons.quote: أخبرني محمد بن عبد الأعلى، قال حدثنا محمد، - وهو ابن ثور - عن معمر، عن الزهري، عن عبد الرحمن بن كعب بن مالك، عن أبيه،

note: The isnad runs linearly from Zuhayr b. Harb through Jarir, Ata b. al-Sa'ib, and Salim al-Barrad.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs linearly from Zuhayr b. Harb through Jarir, Ata b. al-Sa'ib, and Salim al-Barrad.
reasons.quote: حدثنا زهير بن حرب، حدثنا جرير، عن عطاء بن السائب، عن سالم البراد،

reasons.claim: Uqba b. Amr al-Ansari Abu Mas'ud is asked and demonstrates the Prophet's prayer, making him the last link with his kunya kept as one name.
reasons.quote: قال أتينا عقبة بن عمرو الأنصاري أبا مسعود فقلنا له حدثنا عن صلاة، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Basri through Bishr (excluding the editor's gloss between dashes), Shu'ba, Ash'ath b. Sulaym, his father as a bare relation, and Masruq.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Basri through Bishr (excluding the editor's gloss between dashes), Shu'ba, Ash'ath b. Sulaym, his father as a bare relation, and Masruq.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن إبراهيم البصري، عن بشر، - هو ابن المفضل - قال حدثنا شعبة، عن أشعث بن سليم، عن أبيه، عن مسروق،

reasons.claim: Masruq asks Aisha and she answers, so Aisha is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال قلت لعائشة أى الأعمال أحب إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قالت الدائم

note: The isnad runs from Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba through Abu Khalid al-Ahmar Sulayman b. Hayyan (one man), Mansur b. Hayyan (one man), and Abu al-Tufayl.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba through Abu Khalid al-Ahmar Sulayman b. Hayyan (one man), Mansur b. Hayyan (one man), and Abu al-Tufayl.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو خالد الأحمر، سليمان بن حيان عن منصور، بن حيان عن أبي الطفيل،

reasons.claim: Ali b. Abi Talib is asked and answers with the Prophet's saying, making Ali the last link.
reasons.quote: قال قلنا لعلي بن أبي طالب أخبرنا بشىء، أسره إليك رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال

note: The single chain runs from Qutayba through Sufyan, al-Zuhri, and Ubayd Allah b. Abd Allah to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, with «رواية» excluded as a transmission noun.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Qutayba through Sufyan, al-Zuhri, and Ubayd Allah b. Abd Allah to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, with «رواية» excluded as a transmission noun.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قتيبة، حدثنا سفيان، عن الزهري، عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، رواية

reasons.claim: The closing mention of Jabir, Ibn Abbas, and Abu Hurayra is al-Tirmidhi's chapter-parallels remark rather than a route of this saying.
reasons.quote: قال وفي الباب عن جابر، وابن، عباس وأبي هريرة

note: The chain opens with Qutayba, Abu Awana, and Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, who asks Zirr b. Hubaysh.

reasons.claim: The chain opens with Qutayba, Abu Awana, and Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, who asks Zirr b. Hubaysh.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قتيبة، حدثنا أبو عوانة، حدثنا أبو إسحاق الشيباني، قال سألت زر بن حبيش

reasons.claim: Zirr answers by transmitting from Ibn Mas'ud, making Zirr a link and Ibn Mas'ud the last link.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا ابن مسعود أنه رأى جبريل له ستمائة جناح‏.

note: The isnad branches at the co-transmitters Hammam and Aban b. Yazid al-Attar and continues through Yahya and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to his father as a bare relation.

reasons.claim: The isnad branches at the co-transmitters Hammam and Aban b. Yazid al-Attar and continues through Yahya and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to his father as a bare relation.
reasons.quote: حدثنا الحسن بن علي، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، أخبرنا همام، وأبان بن يزيد العطار، عن يحيى، عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة، عن أبيه،

reasons.claim: The later mention of Hammam introduces a wording addition from the same transmitter already in the chain, not a new route.
reasons.quote: وزاد عن همام قال وكان يطول في الركعة الأولى

note: The chain runs from Ali b. Ja'far to Musa b. Ja'far, with «أخيه» kept with the named person as one link and the blessing excluded.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Ali b. Ja'far to Musa b. Ja'far, with «أخيه» kept with the named person as one link and the blessing excluded.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: The question pronoun in «سَأَلْتُهُ» refers to Musa b. Ja'far already named, adding no further link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ بِامْرَأَةٍ

note: The single chain runs from Suwayd b. Nasr through Abd Allah, Hisham, Yahya b. Abi Kathir, and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to his father as a bare relation, ending before the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Suwayd b. Nasr through Abd Allah, Hisham, Yahya b. Abi Kathir, and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to his father as a bare relation, ending before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا سويد بن نصر، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن هشام، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: Zuhayr b. Harb and Ishaq b. Ibrahim are co-transmitters who both transmit from Jarir, with their repeated names only specifying their respective transmission verbs and wording.

reasons.claim: Zuhayr b. Harb and Ishaq b. Ibrahim are co-transmitters who both transmit from Jarir, with their repeated names only specifying their respective transmission verbs and wording.
reasons.quote: حدثنا زهير بن حرب، وإسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال، زهير - واللفظ له - حدثنا جرير،

reasons.claim: From Jarir the shared tail continues through al-A'mash, Abu al-Duha, and Masruq to Aisha.
reasons.quote: حدثنا جرير، عن الأعمش، عن أبي الضحى، عن مسروق، عن عائشة،

note: The single chain runs through Sulayman b. Dawud al-Mahri, Ibn Wahb, Amr b. al-Harith, Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim, Muhammad b. Ja'far b. al-Zubayr, and Abbad b. Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr to Aisha, omitting her epithet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through Sulayman b. Dawud al-Mahri, Ibn Wahb, Amr b. al-Harith, Abd al-Rahman b. al-Qasim, Muhammad b. Ja'far b. al-Zubayr, and Abbad b. Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr to Aisha, omitting her epithet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا سليمان بن داود المهري، أخبرنا ابن وهب، أخبرني عمرو بن الحارث، أن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، حدثه أن محمد بن جعفر بن الزبير حدثه أن عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير حدثه أنه، سمع عائشة، زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: Three co-transmitters share the first level under «قالوا حدثنا», and the gloss «- واللفظ له -» is omitted.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level under «قالوا حدثنا», and the gloss «- واللفظ له -» is omitted.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، ومحمد بن المثنى، ويعقوب بن إبراهيم، - واللفظ له - قالوا حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد

reasons.claim: The chain runs through جعفر بن محمد and the bare relation «أبي» to جابر بن عبد الله, who is asked and answers as the last link.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا جعفر بن محمد، قال حدثني أبي قال، أتينا جابر بن عبد الله فسألناه عن حجة النبي، صلى الله عليه وسلم فحدثنا

note: The two co-transmitters converge at ابن عيينة under «جميعا عن», and the dashed wording gloss repeating the same teacher is omitted.

reasons.claim: The two co-transmitters converge at ابن عيينة under «جميعا عن», and the dashed wording gloss repeating the same teacher is omitted.
reasons.quote: حدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم الحنظلي، وابن أبي عمر، جميعا عن ابن عيينة، - قال إسحاق أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة، -

reasons.claim: The shared tail continues in order through أبي يعفور, مسلم بن صبيح, and مسروق to عائشة as the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي يعفور، عن مسلم بن صبيح، عن مسروق، عن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - قالت

note: The chain runs in order from إبراهيم بن حمزة through عبيد الله بن عبد الله to عبد الله بن عباس.

reasons.claim: The chain runs in order from إبراهيم بن حمزة through عبيد الله بن عبد الله to عبد الله بن عباس.
reasons.quote: حدثنا إبراهيم بن حمزة، قال حدثنا إبراهيم بن سعد، عن صالح، عن ابن شهاب، عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله، أن عبد الله بن عباس، أخبره

note: The single chain runs from Ali b. Abd Allah through Shababa, Shu'ba, Qatada, and Uqba b. Sahban to Abd Allah b. Mughaffal al-Muzani, whose own words open the matn.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Ali b. Abd Allah through Shababa, Shu'ba, Qatada, and Uqba b. Sahban to Abd Allah b. Mughaffal al-Muzani, whose own words open the matn.
reasons.quote: حدثنا علي بن عبد الله، حدثنا شبابة، حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، قال سمعت عقبة بن صهبان، عن عبد الله بن مغفل المزني، إني ممن شهد الشجرة،

note: The single chain runs from Ibn al-Sarh through Ibn Wahb, Yunus, Ibn Shihab, Abd al-Rahman b. Abd Allah b. Ka'b b. Malik, and Abd Allah b. Ka'b to Ka'b b. Malik.

reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن السرح، أخبرنا ابن وهب، أخبرني يونس، عن ابن شهاب، قال أخبرني عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك، أن عبد الله بن كعب، قال سمعت كعب بن مالك،

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Ali b. Abd Allah through Sufyan, Isma'il, and Qays to Abu Hurayra, who speaks in the narrated visit.

note: The four co-transmitters share the chain from Abd al-Razzaq down to Rafi' b. Khadij, ending before the Prophet.

reasons.claim: Al-Tirmidhi's post-matn commentary quoting Ibn Mahdi's juristic opinion is not a route of this Prophetic saying, though it would add a separate saying route if commentary chains are ruled to be separate sayings.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Nasr b. Ali al-Jahdami through Sufyan b. Uyayna to either Salim Abi al-Nadr or Zayd b. Aslam as alternatives, then Ubayd Allah b. Abi Rafi' and «أبيه», ending before the Prophet.

reasons.quote: سمعت أبا داود يقول أبو المهزم ضعيف والحديثان جميعا وهم

reasons.claim: The chain runs in order from al-Hasan b. Ali al-Khallal through Amr b. Dinar (omitting his epithet), Salim b. Abd Allah b. Umar, and the bare relation «أبي» to Umar b. al-Khattab.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Ubayd Allah b. al-Fadl b. Muhammad b. Hilal through Abd al-Rahman, Sa'id b. Khaytham, and his brother Ma'mar to Zayd b. Ali as the speaker.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muhammad b. Isa through Hajjaj, Ibn Jurayj, Umar b. Ata', and an unnamed client of Ibn al-Asqa' (omitting the gloss «- رجل صدق -») to Ibn al-Asqa', ending before the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs in order from 'Abd Allah al-Qa'nabi through Malik, Yazid ibn Khusayfa, 'Amr ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Ka'b al-Sulami, and Nafi' ibn Jubayr to 'Uthman ibn Abi al-'As.

note: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Muhammad ibn Hatim are co-transmitters from Waki', followed by Sufyan, al-Jurayri, and the back reference.

reasons.claim: The closing remark gives a wording variant from Ibn Hatim and an explanatory gloss, not a new route.
reasons.quote: وقال ابن حاتم في روايته ارتأى رجل برأيه ما شاء ‏.‏ يعني عمر

reasons.claim: The two occurrences of Yahya are separated by al-Awza'i and stand as two distinct links in the chain.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Muhammad ibn Kathir through Sufyan, al-A'mash, and Zayd ibn Wahb to Hudhayfa as the last link.

reasons.claim: The continuation introduces the second saying from Hudhayfa with no separate isnad of its own.

reasons.claim: Yahya ibn Yahya, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shayba, and Abu Kurayb are three co-transmitters who all converge on Abu Mu'awiya.

reasons.claim: Abu 'Abd Allah is named after the chain as the speaker of the saying and is the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs in order from Abu 'Ubayd Allah Muhammad ibn 'Imran al-Marzubani through six transmitters to Salim ibn Abi al-Ja'd.

reasons.quote: حدثنا أبوطالب المظفر بن جعفر بن المظفر العلوي رضي الله عنه قال: حدثنا جعفر بن محمد بن مسعود، عن أبيه أبي النضر محمد بن مسعود بن محمد بن عياش العياشي قال: حدثنا جعفر بن أحمد قال: حدثني علي بن محمد بن شجاع، عن محمد ابن عثمان، عن حميد بن محمد، عن أحمد بن الحسن بن صالح، عن أبيه، عن الفتح بن يزيد الجرجاني

reasons.claim: Al-Fath b. Yazid wrote to Abu al-Hasan who answered, making the Imam the last link.
reasons.quote: أنه كتب إلى أبي الحسن عليه السلام سأله

note: The text gives two separate routes joined by «ح», each writing its own transmitters down to Ibn Umar, with «- واللفظ له -» omitted as a gloss.

reasons.claim: The text gives two separate routes joined by «ح», each writing its own transmitters down to Ibn Umar, with «- واللفظ له -» omitted as a gloss.
reasons.quote: حدثنا شيبان بن فروخ، حدثنا عبد العزيز بن مسلم، حدثنا عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر، ح وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، - واللفظ له - عن مالك بن أنس، عن عبد الله بن دينار، عن ابن عمر،

note: The chain runs linearly through seven transmitters ending at the Companion Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, while the man who approaches the Prophet in the scene is not a transmitter.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through seven transmitters ending at the Companion Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, while the man who approaches the Prophet in the scene is not a transmitter.

note: The report gives a single linear chain of five transmitters ending at the Companion referred to by title.

reasons.claim: The report gives a single linear chain of five transmitters ending at the Companion referred to by title.

reasons.claim: Because «أم المؤمنين» is the speaker whose words are relayed, she is the last link in the structure whether or not the owner rules specially on a source known only by a title, and the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن أم المؤمنين، قالت أنا فتلت

note: The chain runs linearly from the compiler through six named transmitters before branching at the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from the compiler through six named transmitters before branching at the last link.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا الخليل بن أحمد قال: أخبرنا ابن منيع قال: حدثنا مصعب قال: حدثني مالك، عن أبي عبدالرحمن، عن حفص بن عاصم،

reasons.claim: The disjunction «أو» places the two Companions as alternatives at the final level, producing two routes, with the Prophet ending the chain.
reasons.quote: عن أبي سعيد الخدري، أو عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله

note: The isnad is a single linear chain of six transmitters, with «هو ابن إبراهيم» acting as a gloss on «إسماعيل ابن علية» rather than a separate link.

reasons.claim: The isnad is a single linear chain of six transmitters, with «هو ابن إبراهيم» acting as a gloss on «إسماعيل ابن علية» rather than a separate link.

reasons.claim: The remarks after the matn are the compiler's chapter notes and legal commentary with no isnad, not routes of this saying.
reasons.quote: قال وفي الباب عن ابن عباس وأبي رافع ‏.‏ قال أبو عيسى حديث أبي هريرة حديث حسن صحيح

note: Three co-transmitters share the first level, with the clause that follows only distinguishing their transmission verbs.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level, with the clause that follows only distinguishing their transmission verbs.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وأبو بكر بن أبي شيبة وأبو كريب قال يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو معاوية،

reasons.claim: All three routes continue through the same shared tail ending at the Companion.
reasons.quote: أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله

note: The chain runs linearly through six links, including the unnamed father as a relation link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through six links, including the unnamed father as a relation link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن عمرو بن السرح، حدثنا ابن وهب، عن عمرو بن الحارث، أن حبان بن واسع، حدثه أن أباه حدثه

reasons.claim: The Companion who recounts seeing the Prophet's ablution is the last link, and the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: سمع عبد الله بن زيد بن عاصم المازني، يذكر أنه رأى رسول الله

note: The report has a single linear chain of five transmitters from the compiler's shaykh down to the Companion.

reasons.claim: The report has a single linear chain of five transmitters from the compiler's shaykh down to the Companion.
reasons.quote: أخبرني عمرو بن عثمان بن سعيد بن كثير، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر، أنه سمع أبا الأشعث، حدثه أنه، سمع أوس بن أوس،

reasons.claim: The descriptive phrase «صاحب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم» is omitted from the surface, and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: أوس بن أوس، صاحب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول قال رسول الله

note: The chain runs linearly through six transmitters, with «عن أبيه، شكل بن حميد» naming one link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through six transmitters, with «عن أبيه، شكل بن حميد» naming one link.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا الحسين بن إسحاق، قال حدثنا أبو نعيم، قال حدثنا سعد بن أوس، قال حدثني بلال بن يحيى، أن شتير بن شكل، أخبره عن أبيه، شكل بن حميد

reasons.claim: The closing remark by Sa'd is a lexical gloss on a word in the matn, not a new route.
reasons.quote: قال سعد والمني ماؤه

note: The conversion marker «ح» introduces a second branch, and both branches share the tail written once after the wording note.

reasons.claim: The conversion marker «ح» introduces a second branch, and both branches share the tail written once after the wording note.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عثمان بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا جرير، ح وحدثنا هناد بن السري، حدثنا أبو معاوية، - وهذا لفظ هناد - عن الأعمش، عن المنهال، عن زاذان، عن البراء بن عازب،

reasons.claim: The interjected wording notes about Jarir's and Hannad's phrasing do not add new routes.
reasons.quote: - زاد في حديث جرير ها هنا -

note: The conversion marker «ح» and the dual verb «قالا» join two branches onto a single shared tail.

reasons.claim: The conversion marker «ح» and the dual verb «قالا» join two branches onto a single shared tail.
reasons.quote: حدثنا علي بن المنذر، حدثنا محمد بن فضيل، ح وحدثنا حوثرة بن محمد، حدثنا محمد بن بشر، قالا حدثنا حجاج بن دينار، عن أبي غالب، عن أبي أمامة،

note: Three co-transmitters share the first level, and «ابن عيينة» followed immediately by «سفيان بن عيينة» is the same man written twice in succession as one link.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level, and «ابن عيينة» followed immediately by «سفيان بن عيينة» is the same man written twice in succession as one link.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وسعيد بن منصور، وعمرو الناقد، جميعا عن ابن عيينة، قال يحيى أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة،

reasons.claim: All three routes continue through the same tail ending at the Companion, while the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن الزهري، عن عبيد الله، عن ابن عباس، عن الصعب، بن جثامة قال سئل النبي

note: The chain runs from Muslim through Shu'ba, al-Shaybani, and al-Sha'bi.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Muslim through Shu'ba, al-Shaybani, and al-Sha'bi.
reasons.quote: حدثنا مسلم، حدثنا شعبة، حدثنا الشيباني، عن الشعبي

reasons.claim: The unnamed transmitter in the report is explicitly named as Ibn Abbas at the end, making him the last link before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: قلت من حدثك قال ابن عباس

note: The chain runs from Yahya b. Musa al-Balkhi through Abu Usama, Mujalid, and Amir to Jabir b. Abd Allah.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Yahya b. Musa al-Balkhi through Abu Usama, Mujalid, and Amir to Jabir b. Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن موسى البلخي، حدثنا أبو أسامة، قال مجالد أخبرنا عن عامر، عن جابر بن عبد الله

note: Two tahwil branches meet at Hisham b. Urwa and share the tail Fatima and Asma, while the wording gloss is excluded.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches meet at Hisham b. Urwa and share the tail Fatima and Asma, while the wording gloss is excluded.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا هشام بن عروة، ح وحدثني محمد بن حاتم، - واللفظ له - حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد، عن هشام بن عروة، قال حدثتني فاطمة، عن أسماء

reasons.claim: The chain runs through seven transmitters ending at Abd Allah.

reasons.claim: The man who came to Abd Allah is a figure in the scene rather than a transmitter link.
reasons.quote: وأتاه، رجل فقال

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at the first level all meet at Abu Mu'awiya and continue through al-A'mash, Ibrahim, and al-Aswad to A'isha.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب وإسحاق بن إبراهيم قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The chain runs through Abu Kamil, Khalid (excluding the editor gloss), Imran b. Muslim, Qays b. Sa'd, and Tawus to Ibn Abbas.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كامل، حدثنا خالد، - يعني ابن الحارث - حدثنا عمران بن مسلم، أن قيس بن سعد، حدثه قال حدثنا طاوس، عن ابن عباس

note: The chain branches at the co-transmitters Ishaq ibn Hamza al-Bukhari and the bare relation «عمي», omits the gloss on Ruqba, includes the unnamed gap «عمن سمع», and ends at Hudhayfa b. Asid.

reasons.claim: The chain branches at the co-transmitters Ishaq ibn Hamza al-Bukhari and the bare relation «عمي», omits the gloss on Ruqba, includes the unnamed gap «عمن سمع», and ends at Hudhayfa b. Asid.
reasons.quote: حدثنا الحسن بن عبد الله بن سعيد العسكري قال: أخبرنا عبد الله بن محمد بن حكيم القاضي قال: حدثنا الحسين بن عبد الله بن شاكر قال: حدثنا إسحاق ابن حمزة البخاري، وعمي قالا: حدثنا عيسى بن موسى غنجار، عن أبي حمزة، عن رقبة وهو ابن مصقلة الشيباني، عن الحكم بن عتيبة، عمن سمع حذيفة بن أسيد

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Ali b. Abd Allah through Sufyan to al-Zuhri, who is named as Sufyan's source.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Hafs b. Umar through Shu'ba and Habib b. Abi Thabit to Abu al-Minhal.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level and report together from Isma'il (with the dashed gloss excluded) and then Humayd.

reasons.quote: قال سألت أنس بن مالك  رضى الله عنه

note: Three co-transmitters share the first level and all report from Jarir, with the wording note and verb difference adding no separate route.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level and all report from Jarir, with the wording note and verb difference adding no separate route.

reasons.claim: The tahwil separates two branches meeting at al-Zuhri, with the second branch having Yunus and Ma'mar as co-transmitters.

reasons.claim: The shared tail after the tahwil runs through Ubayd Allah b. Abd Allah and ends at Ibn Abbas.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level and all report from Ibn Wahb, differing only in transmission verb.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Yahya b. Yahya through Malik (to whom Yahya read) and Nafi' to Ibn Umar.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters share the first level (with the dashed gloss excluded) and report together through Jarir, Mansur, Ibrahim, and Alqama to Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن عيسى، وعثمان بن أبي شيبة، - المعنى - قالا حدثنا جرير، عن منصور، عن إبراهيم، عن علقمة، عن عبد الله

note: The first route runs from أبو الحسن (omitting the gloss «- أى القطان -») through أبو حاتم and أبو الوليد to عمارة بن زاذان.

reasons.claim: The first branch has three co-transmitters at the first level leading through محمد بن جعفر, شعبة, عطاء بن أبي ميمونة, and أبا رافع to أبي، هريرة.

reasons.quote: حدثنا علي بن حجر السعدي، حدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر، والوليد بن مسلم - قال ابن حجر دخل حديث أحدهما في حديث الآخر - عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: The later mention of Ibn Hujr's narration is a wording remark rather than a new route.
reasons.quote: وفي رواية ابن حجر

note: Three co-transmitters at the top level share Abd al-Razzaq and the chain continues to Ibn Umar before the Prophet.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at the top level share Abd al-Razzaq and the chain continues to Ibn Umar before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى، والحسن بن علي، وإسحاق بن منصور، قالوا حدثنا عبد الرزاق، حدثنا معمر، عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن النبي

note: Two tahwil branches with two co-transmitters in the second branch meet at al-Awza'i.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches with two co-transmitters in the second branch meet at al-Awza'i.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا محمد بن مصعب، عن الأوزاعي، ح وحدثنا هشام بن عمار، وعبد الرحمن بن إبراهيم، قالا حدثنا الوليد بن مسلم، حدثنا الأوزاعي

reasons.claim: The shared tail written once after al-Awza'i runs through al-Zuhri and Urwah to A'ishah before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن الزهري، عن عروة، عن عائشة، عن النبي

note: The single chain runs from Qutayba through al-Layth, Uqayl, al-Zuhri, and Hamza b. Abd Allah b. Umar to Ibn Umar as the last link.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Qutayba through al-Layth, Uqayl, al-Zuhri, and Hamza b. Abd Allah b. Umar to Ibn Umar as the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قتيبة، حدثنا الليث، عن عقيل، عن الزهري، عن حمزة بن عبد الله بن عمر، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: The Prophet ends the chain and is not a link, and both readers agree on the exact route.
reasons.quote: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: The opening chain runs from Ahmad b. Isa through Ibn Wahb and Amr to Bukayr b. al-Ashajj.

reasons.claim: The opening chain runs from Ahmad b. Isa through Ibn Wahb and Amr to Bukayr b. al-Ashajj.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن عيسى، حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني عمرو، عن بكير بن الأشج

reasons.claim: Inside Bukayr's narrated encounter, Sulayman speaks and transmits from Abd al-Rahman b. Jabir, his father, and Abu Burda al-Ansari, who heard the Prophet.
reasons.quote: فأقبل، علينا سليمان فقال حدثني عبد الرحمن بن جابر، عن أبيه، عن أبي بردة الأنصاري، أنه سمع رسول الله

note: Three co-transmitters, including an unnamed link, transmit from Ali b. Ibrahim, his father, and Ali b. Mahziyar.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters, including an unnamed link, transmit from Ali b. Ibrahim, his father, and Ali b. Mahziyar.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ غَيْرُهُمَا عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ

reasons.claim: Ali b. Mahziyar questions Abu Ja'far, who answers in the text and is therefore the last link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ (ع)

note: The report opens passively from Ayyub brother of Udaym, who relays the answer of Abu Abd Allah as the last link.

reasons.claim: The report opens passively from Ayyub brother of Udaym, who relays the answer of Abu Abd Allah as the last link.
reasons.quote: وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ أَخِي أُدَيْمٍ قَالَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

note: Three co-transmitters share the first level and all transmit from Hafs b. Ghiyath.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share the first level and all transmit from Hafs b. Ghiyath.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وابن، نمير وزهير بن حرب جميعا عن حفص، بن غياث

reasons.claim: The parenthetical remark only specifies Ibn Numayr's transmission verb from Hafs, and the chain continues through Muhammad b. Zayd to Umayr mawla Abi al-Lahm.
reasons.quote: - قال ابن نمير حدثنا حفص، - عن محمد بن زيد، عن عمير، مولى آبي اللحم

note: An unnamed transmitter reports an incident involving al-Sadiq.

reasons.claim: An unnamed transmitter reports an incident involving al-Sadiq.
reasons.quote: وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: خَرَجَ اَلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مِنَ اَلْحَمَّامِ

reasons.claim: Al-Sadiq speaks inside the report and is therefore the last link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ «فَمَا تَرَكْتُ اَلْعِمَامَةَ

note: Harun b. Sa'id al-Ayli and Ahmad b. Isa share the first level via the dual verb and meet at Ibn Wahb, continuing through Amr (with an editorial gloss omitted), Bukayr, Asim b. Umar b. Qatada, and Ubayd Allah al-Khawlani to Uthman b. Affan.

reasons.claim: Harun b. Sa'id al-Ayli and Ahmad b. Isa share the first level via the dual verb and meet at Ibn Wahb, continuing through Amr (with an editorial gloss omitted), Bukayr, Asim b. Umar b. Qatada, and Ubayd Allah al-Khawlani to Uthman b. Affan.
reasons.quote: حدثني هارون بن سعيد الأيلي، وأحمد بن عيسى، قالا حدثنا ابن وهب، أخبرني  عمرو، - وهو ابن الحارث - أن بكيرا، حدثه أن عاصم بن عمر بن قتادة حدثه أنه، سمع  عبيد الله الخولاني، يذكر أنه سمع عثمان بن عفان

note: The chain runs linearly from Ali through Sufyan, Amr, and Sa'id b. Jubayr to Ibn Abbas as the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly from Ali through Sufyan, Amr, and Sa'id b. Jubayr to Ibn Abbas as the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا علي، حدثنا سفيان، قال عمرو سمعت سعيد بن جبير، سمعت ابن عباس، سمعت النبي

reasons.claim: Sufyan's closing statement is a comment on Ibn Abbas's hearing and adds no route.
reasons.quote: قال سفيان هذا مما نعد أن ابن عباس سمعه من النبي

note: The dual verb «قالا حدثنا شعبة» joins only the second and third branches (Ubayd Allah b. Mu'adh's father and Muhammad b. Ja'far) to Shu'ba, while «كلاهما عن محمد بن زياد» joins al-Rabi' (branch 1) and Shu'ba (branches 2 and 3) directly to Muhammad b. Ziyad and Abu Hurayra; both readers wrongly inserted Shu'ba into al-Rabi's branch.

reasons.claim: The dual verb «قالا حدثنا شعبة» joins only the second and third branches (Ubayd Allah b. Mu'adh's father and Muhammad b. Ja'far) to Shu'ba, while «كلاهما عن محمد بن زياد» joins al-Rabi' (branch 1) and Shu'ba (branches 2 and 3) directly to Muhammad b. Ziyad and Abu Hurayra; both readers wrongly inserted Shu'ba into al-Rabi's branch.
reasons.quote: حدثنا الربيع يعني ابن مسلم، ح وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي ح، وحدثنا ابن بشار، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، قالا حدثنا شعبة، كلاهما عن محمد بن زياد، عن أبي هريرة

notes: «قالا حدثنا شعبة» (dual) applies to أبي and محمد بن جعفر; «كلاهما عن محمد بن زياد» (dual) applies to الربيع and شعبة.

note: The text is a legal exposition opening directly on the rules of Hajj with no transmitter or isnad.

reasons.claim: The text is a legal exposition opening directly on the rules of Hajj with no transmitter or isnad.
reasons.quote: والحاج على ثلاثة أوجه: قارن، ومفرد، ومتمتع بالعمرة إلى الحج

note: Two tahwil branches of co-transmitters meet at Mansur via «كلاهما عن منصور» and share the tail through al-Sha'bi to al-Bara' b. 'Azib, yielding four routes.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches of co-transmitters meet at Mansur via «كلاهما عن منصور» and share the tail through al-Sha'bi to al-Bara' b. 'Azib, yielding four routes.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، وهناد بن السري، قالا حدثنا أبو الأحوص، ح وحدثنا  عثمان بن أبي شيبة، وإسحاق بن إبراهيم، جميعا عن جرير، كلاهما عن منصور، عن الشعبي، عن البراء بن عازب

reasons.claim: The closing wording remark is not a separate route.
reasons.quote: ثم ذكر نحو حديثهم

note: Two co-transmitters share the single chain from Yahya through Ibn 'Abbas, and the editor gloss «- المعنى -» is excluded.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters share the single chain from Yahya through Ibn 'Abbas, and the editor gloss «- المعنى -» is excluded.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، ومسدد، - المعنى - قالا حدثنا يحيى، عن عبيد الله بن الأخنس، عن الوليد بن عبد الله، عن يوسف بن ماهك، عن ابن عباس

note: The chain runs from Ibn Bashshar through Tawus to Ibn 'Umar, who is asked and answers as the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Ibn Bashshar through Tawus to Ibn 'Umar, who is asked and answers as the last link.
reasons.quote: حدثنا ابن بشار، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن أبي شعيب، عن طاوس، قال سئل ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Abu Dawud's closing remark on the narrator's name is a comment, not a route, and «أبي شعيب» is kept as written.
reasons.quote: قال أبو داود سمعت يحيى بن معين يقول هو شعيب يعني وهم شعبة في اسمه

note: The single chain runs from 'Ubayd Allah b. Sa'id through Sufyan, 'Amr, 'Ata', and Habiba bt. Maysara to Umm Karz, who relays the Prophet's saying.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from 'Ubayd Allah b. Sa'id through Sufyan, 'Amr, 'Ata', and Habiba bt. Maysara to Umm Karz, who relays the Prophet's saying.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا عبيد الله بن سعيد، قال حدثنا سفيان، قال قال عمرو عن عطاء، عن حبيبة بنت ميسرة، عن أم كرز

note: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Mansur through Ibn 'Umar to Hafsa, who is the last link relaying the Prophet's practice.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Mansur through Ibn 'Umar to Hafsa, who is the last link relaying the Prophet's practice.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن منصور، قال حدثنا سفيان، قال حدثنا عمرو، عن الزهري، عن سالم، عن ابن عمر، قال أخبرتني حفصة

note: The chain runs from 'Ali b. 'Abd Allah al-Warraq through Salama b. Muhriz to Abu 'Abd Allah, who is named in the text and answers the question as the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from 'Ali b. 'Abd Allah al-Warraq through Salama b. Muhriz to Abu 'Abd Allah, who is named in the text and answers the question as the last link.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنا عَلِىُّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الوَرَّاقُ قالَ: حَدَّثَنا سَعْدُ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبِيْدٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمنِ، عَنْ صَفْوانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبي أَيُّوب الخَزَّارِ، عَنْ سَلَمَةِ بْنِ مُحْرِزٍ قالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ‏ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ

note: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Kathir through 'Ikrima to Ibn 'Abbas, whose commentary on the verse is the matn.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Kathir through 'Ikrima to Ibn 'Abbas, whose commentary on the verse is the matn.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن كثير، أخبرنا إسرائيل، حدثنا سماك، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عباس، في قوله

note: The single chain runs from Yahya b. Yahya through Malik, Nafi', and Ibn 'Umar to 'A'isha, who relays her encounter with the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Yahya b. Yahya through Malik, Nafi', and Ibn 'Umar to 'A'isha, who relays her encounter with the Prophet.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن عائشة

note: The single chain runs from the compiler's father («أبي») through Ahmad b. Idris, Ya'qub b. Yazid, Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr, and Muhammad al-Qibti to Abu 'Abd Allah as the last link.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from the compiler's father («أبي») through Ahmad b. Idris, Ya'qub b. Yazid, Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr, and Muhammad al-Qibti to Abu 'Abd Allah as the last link.
reasons.quote: أبي رحمة الله قال حدثنا أحمد بن إدريس قال حدّثنا يعقوب بن يزيد… …عن محمد بن أبي عمير عن محمّد القبطي قال سمعت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام يقول

note: Two tahwil branches meet at Hakim b. Jabir and share the final link 'Ubada b. al-Samit.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches meet at Hakim b. Jabir and share the final link 'Ubada b. al-Samit.
reasons.quote: أخبرني هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا أبو أسامة، قال قال إسماعيل حدثنا حكيم بن جابر، ح وأنبأنا يعقوب بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا يحيى، عن إسماعيل، قال حدثنا حكيم بن جابر، عن عبادة بن الصامت

reasons.claim: The wording note about Ya'qub and the subsequent exchange with Mu'awiya are not routes.
reasons.quote: ولم يذكر يعقوب ‏"‏ الكفة بالكفة ‏"‏

note: The report opens with a back reference naming no speaker or transmitter.

reasons.claim: The report opens with a back reference naming no speaker or transmitter.
reasons.quote: وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:

reasons.claim: Passing over prev1 which has no written chain, prev2 supplies the Imam as the speaker.
reasons.quote: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

note: The isnad runs in one route from Hannad through Hushaym, Ibn Abi Layla, and Ata to Ibn Abbas, ending at the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs in one route from Hannad through Hushaym, Ibn Abi Layla, and Ata to Ibn Abbas, ending at the Prophet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا هناد، حدثنا هشيم، عن ابن أبي ليلى، عن عطاء، عن ابن عباس، يرفع الحديث

reasons.claim: The chapter note and the compiler's grading comment after the matn are not routes of this saying.
reasons.quote: قال وفي الباب عن عبد الله بن عمرو ‏.‏ قال أبو عيسى حديث ابن عباس حديث صحيح

note: The single route runs from al-Hasan b. Umar b. Shaqiq through Mu'tamir and his unnamed father (relation) to Abu Uthman and Salman al-Farisi.

reasons.claim: The single route runs from al-Hasan b. Umar b. Shaqiq through Mu'tamir and his unnamed father (relation) to Abu Uthman and Salman al-Farisi.
reasons.quote: حدثني الحسن بن عمر بن شقيق، حدثنا معتمر، قال أبي وحدثنا أبو عثمان، عن سلمان الفارسي،

note: The first isnad runs from Adam through Ibn Abi Dhi'b and al-Zuhri to two co-transmitters, Sa'id and Abi Salama, and then to Abu Hurayra.

reasons.claim: The first isnad runs from Adam through Ibn Abi Dhi'b and al-Zuhri to two co-transmitters, Sa'id and Abi Salama, and then to Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: حدثنا آدم، قال حدثنا ابن أبي ذئب، قال الزهري عن سعيد، وأبي، سلمة عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: The second isnad carries the same saying through Abu al-Yaman, Shu'ayb, al-Zuhri, Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rahman, and Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا أبو اليمان، قال أخبرنا شعيب، عن الزهري، قال أخبرني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، أن أبا هريرة،

note: The isnad runs from Yusuf b. Hammad al-Ma'ni through Ziyad (omitting the gloss), Husayn, and Kathir b. Mudrik al-Ashja'i to co-transmitters Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid and al-Aswad b. Yazid, ending at Abd Allah b. Mas'ud.

reasons.claim: The isnad runs from Yusuf b. Hammad al-Ma'ni through Ziyad (omitting the gloss), Husayn, and Kathir b. Mudrik al-Ashja'i to co-transmitters Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid and al-Aswad b. Yazid, ending at Abd Allah b. Mas'ud.
reasons.quote: وحدثنيه يوسف بن حماد المعني، حدثنا زياد، - يعني البكائي - عن حصين، عن كثير بن مدرك الأشجعي، عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد، والأسود بن يزيد، قالا سمعنا عبد، الله بن مسعود

note: The single chain runs from Ahmad b. Salih through Anbasa b. Khalid, Yunus b. Yazid, Muhammad b. Muslim b. Shihab, and Urwa b. al-Zubayr to Aisha, omitting her blessing and epithet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Ahmad b. Salih through Anbasa b. Khalid, Yunus b. Yazid, Muhammad b. Muslim b. Shihab, and Urwa b. al-Zubayr to Aisha, omitting her blessing and epithet.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن صالح، حدثنا عنبسة بن خالد، حدثني يونس بن يزيد، قال قال محمد بن مسلم بن شهاب أخبرني عروة بن الزبير، أن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - زوج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أخبرته

note: The chain opens with the compiler's father as a relation link, passes through Sa'd b. Abd Allah, al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi, Muhammad b. Khabbab al-Qammat, and an unnamed shaykh, and ends at the Imam named in the text.

reasons.claim: The chain opens with the compiler's father as a relation link, passes through Sa'd b. Abd Allah, al-Haytham b. Abi Masruq al-Nahdi, Muhammad b. Khabbab al-Qammat, and an unnamed shaykh, and ends at the Imam named in the text.
reasons.quote: أَبِی ره قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی الْهَیْثَمُ بْنُ أَبِی مَسْرُوقٍ النَّهْدِیُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ الْقَمَّاطٍ عَنْ شَیْخٍ کَانَ عِنْدَنَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع یَقُولُ

note: The report opens with a back reference inheriting the full chain of prev1.

reasons.claim: The report opens with a back reference inheriting the full chain of prev1.
reasons.quote: وبإسناده قال

reasons.claim: Prev1 supplies the five-link chain from Abu al-Yaman through Shu'ayb, Abu al-Zinad, and Abd al-Rahman b. Hurmuz al-A'raj to Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو اليمان، قال أخبرنا شعيب، قال أخبرنا أبو الزناد، أن عبد الرحمن بن هرمز الأعرج، حدثه أنه، سمع أبا هريرة،

note: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman b. Sahm al-Antaki through Ibrahim b. Muhammad Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, Abi Ishaq al-Shaybani, Muharib b. Dithar, and Abd Allah b. Yazid to al-Bara'.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman b. Sahm al-Antaki through Ibrahim b. Muhammad Abu Ishaq al-Fazari, Abi Ishaq al-Shaybani, Muharib b. Dithar, and Abd Allah b. Yazid to al-Bara'.
reasons.quote: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سهم الأنطاكي، حدثنا إبراهيم بن محمد أبو إسحاق الفزاري، عن أبي إسحاق الشيباني، عن محارب بن دثار، قال سمعت عبد الله بن يزيد، يقول على المنبر حدثنا البراء،

note: The chain opens with co-transmitters Muhammad b. al-Ala' and Ibrahim b. Musa al-Razi, then runs through Abu Usama, Umar (omitting the parenthetical gloss), and Abd al-Rahman b. Sa'd to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri.

reasons.claim: Three tahwil branches converge at al-A'mash, with three co-transmitters in the first branch and the editor gloss omitted from the third.

reasons.claim: The isnad is a single linear chain of five transmitters including al-Sha'bi and ending at al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا عبيد الله الأشجعي، عن عبد الملك بن أبجر، قال سمعت الشعبي، يقول سمعت المغيرة بن شعبة،

note: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim narrates from two co-transmitters who narrate from their fathers and then through a single family chain.

reasons.claim: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim narrates from two co-transmitters who narrate from their fathers and then through a single family chain.

reasons.quote: عن أخيه الحسن بن علي (عليهم السلام)، قال: قال أمير المؤمنين (عليه السلام):

note: Two tahwil branches both pass through Abu Mu'awiya and share the tail written once after the second branch ending at Abu Hurayra.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches both pass through Abu Mu'awiya and share the tail written once after the second branch ending at Abu Hurayra.

reasons.claim: The chain runs linearly through four transmitters, collapsing the relation before Sa'id ibn Fulan, omitting the identifying gloss, and ending at Umm Khalid bint Khalid.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters share Isma'il (omitting the gloss) through Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb to Anas, who relays from the Prophet.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا أحمد بن حنبل، وأبو بكر بن أبي شيبة وزهير بن حرب قالوا حدثنا إسماعيل، - يعنون ابن علية - عن عبد العزيز بن صهيب، عن أنس، عن النبي

note: Two branches separated by «ح» meet at «قالا جميعا حدثنا» and share the tail through Anas, with «أبو النضر، هاشم بن القاسم» as one man.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters share the chain through Wahb b. Munabbih, his unnamed brother, and Mu'awiya as the last link relaying the Prophet's words.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أحمد بن صالح، وأحمد بن عمرو بن السرح، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن عمرو بن دينار، عن وهب بن منبه، عن أخيه، عن معاوية،

note: The single chain runs from Musa b. Isma'il through Juwayriya and Nafi' to 'Abd Allah, excluding the blessing and the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Musa b. Isma'il through Juwayriya and Nafi' to 'Abd Allah, excluding the blessing and the Prophet.

note: Three co-transmitters transmit jointly from Isma'il b. Ja'far (with the parenthetical wording note excluded) through Sa'd b. Sa'id, 'Umar b. Kathir b. Aflah, and Ibn Safina to Umm Salama.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters transmit jointly from Isma'il b. Ja'far (with the parenthetical wording note excluded) through Sa'd b. Sa'id, 'Umar b. Kathir b. Aflah, and Ibn Safina to Umm Salama.

note: The single chain runs from 'Amr b. 'Asim through Hammam, Ishaq b. 'Abd Allah, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi 'Amra to Abu Hurayra, who heard the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from 'Amr b. 'Asim through Hammam, Ishaq b. 'Abd Allah, and 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi 'Amra to Abu Hurayra, who heard the Prophet.

note: The chain runs from 'Amr b. Sawwad (excluding the parenthetical genealogical gloss) through Ibn Wahb, 'Amr b. al-Harith, Bukayr, and Kurayb to 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas as the last link.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from 'Amr b. Sawwad (excluding the parenthetical genealogical gloss) through Ibn Wahb, 'Amr b. al-Harith, Bukayr, and Kurayb to 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas as the last link.

note: Four «وعن» routes share the head Sahl b. Abi Sahl to Sufyan and each ends at Ibn 'Umar (written «أبيه» in the first route).

note: The chain runs from Qutayba b. Sa'id through 'Abd al-'Aziz and Abu Hazim to Sahl b. Sa'd, who is asked and answers with the Prophet's saying.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Qutayba b. Sa'id through 'Abd al-'Aziz and Abu Hazim to Sahl b. Sa'd, who is asked and answers with the Prophet's saying.

reasons.quote: وقد روي هذا، عن أيوب، عن عمرو بن دينار، عن عروة بن عامر، عن عبيد بن رفاعة، عن أسماء بنت عميس، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: The second sentence supplies the connecting chain from al-Tirmidhi down to Ayyub after the names it connects to, which cannot be represented as a single merged route in the reader format.
reasons.quote: حدثنا بذلك الحسن بن علي الخلال، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، عن معمر، عن أيوب، بهذا

note: Following al-Faqih's convention, the chain runs from al-Saduq through Ibn Muskan and Abu Sa'id to Abu Abd Allah, who is asked and answers.

note: The chain runs linearly from al-Bukhari through Yahya b. Musa, Waki, Isma'il, and Qays to Khabbab, whose own words are relayed while the clause about cauterization describes his condition.

note: The report opens mid-chain with Suhayl and runs linearly through Ubayd Allah b. Miqsam to Abu Salih, with no other transmitters written in the text.

reasons.claim: The report opens mid-chain with Suhayl and runs linearly through Ubayd Allah b. Miqsam to Abu Salih, with no other transmitters written in the text.

note: Three co-transmitters—the compiler's father as a relation link, Muhammad b. al-Hasan, and Ali b. al-Husayn—open the chain and share the remaining links.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters—the compiler's father as a relation link, Muhammad b. al-Hasan, and Ali b. al-Husayn—open the chain and share the remaining links.
reasons.quote: وَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The shared tail runs linearly to Abu Abd Allah as the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

note: The single chain runs linearly from Isma'il b. Mas'ud through Khalid, Hisham, Yahya, and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to Abu Qatada, with the dashed gloss on Khalid omitted.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs linearly from Isma'il b. Mas'ud through Khalid, Hisham, Yahya, and Abd Allah b. Abi Qatada to Abu Qatada, with the dashed gloss on Khalid omitted.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا إسماعيل بن مسعود، قال حدثنا خالد، - يعني ابن الحارث - قال حدثنا هشام، عن يحيى، عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة، عن أبي قتادة

note: The chain runs from al-Saduq through al-Ala and Muhammad b. Muslim to an unnamed Imam.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from al-Saduq through al-Ala and Muhammad b. Muslim to an unnamed Imam.
reasons.quote: رَوَى الْعَلَاءُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا

reasons.claim: Muhammad b. Muslim asks and the unnamed Imam answers, making the unnamed Imam the last link.
reasons.quote: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّهْنِ وَ الْكَفِيلِ فِي بَيْعِ النَّسِيئَةِ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ

note: The single chain runs through Abd Allah b. Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi, Yahya, Mu'awiya, a second Yahya, Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rahman, and Jabir, leaving out the two parenthetical glosses.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through Abd Allah b. Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi, Yahya, Mu'awiya, a second Yahya, Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rahman, and Jabir, leaving out the two parenthetical glosses.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الدارمي، أخبرنا يحيى، - يعني ابن حسان - حدثنا معاوية، - وهو ابن سلام - أخبرني يحيى، أخبرني أبو سلمة بن عبد الرحمن، أن جابرا، أخبره

note: Three co-transmitters at the first level transmit through al-Layth b. Sa'd, Nafi', and Safiyya bint Abi Ubayd to two alternative last links, Hafsa and Aisha, giving six routes.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters at the first level transmit through al-Layth b. Sa'd, Nafi', and Safiyya bint Abi Ubayd to two alternative last links, Hafsa and Aisha, giving six routes.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وقتيبة، وابن، رمح عن الليث بن سعد، عن نافع، أن صفية، بنت أبي عبيد حدثته عن حفصة، أو عن عائشة، أو عن كلتيهما، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال

note: Two co-transmitters at the first level transmit through Ibn al-Qasim, Malik, Abd al-Majid b. Suhayl, and Sa'id b. al-Musayyib to two co-transmitters at the last level, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayra, yielding four routes.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters at the first level transmit through Ibn al-Qasim, Malik, Abd al-Majid b. Suhayl, and Sa'id b. al-Musayyib to two co-transmitters at the last level, Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurayra, yielding four routes.
reasons.quote: أخبرنا محمد بن سلمة، والحارث بن مسكين، قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، - واللفظ له - عن ابن القاسم، قال حدثني مالك، عن عبد المجيد بن سهيل، عن سعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، وعن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: The explicit transmission verb between Abu Burda b. Abd Allah and Abu Burda shows two distinct links, not a repetition of the same man, so both readers' expanded routes wrongly omit Abu Burda.

reasons.claim: The explicit transmission verb between Abu Burda b. Abd Allah and Abu Burda shows two distinct links, not a repetition of the same man, so both readers' expanded routes wrongly omit Abu Burda.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا أبو بردة بن عبد الله، قال سمعت أبا بردة، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: «قال سمعت أبا بردة» has an explicit hearing verb, so «أبا بردة» is a distinct link after «أبو بردة بن عبد الله».

note: The chain branches into two co-transmitters after Ibn Jurayj and converges on al-Harith b. Abd Allah b. Abi Rabi'a.

reasons.claim: The chain branches into two co-transmitters after Ibn Jurayj and converges on al-Harith b. Abd Allah b. Abi Rabi'a.
reasons.quote: حدثني محمد بن حاتم، حدثنا محمد بن بكر، أخبرنا ابن جريج، قال سمعت عبد، الله بن عبيد بن عمير والوليد بن عطاء يحدثان عن الحارث بن عبد الله بن أبي ربيعة

reasons.claim: Al-Harith explicitly states that he heard the prophetic saying from Aisha, making Aisha the last link.
reasons.quote: سمع من عائشة ما كان يزعم أنه سمعه منها ‏.‏ قال الحارث بلى أنا سمعته منها

note: Two branches separated by «ح» meet at «جميعا عن إبراهيم» and share the tail through Ibrahim, al-Aswad, and Aisha, yielding four routes.

reasons.claim: Two branches separated by «ح» meet at «جميعا عن إبراهيم» and share the tail through Ibrahim, al-Aswad, and Aisha, yielding four routes.
reasons.quote: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وأبو بكر بن أبي شيبة وأبو كريب عن أبي معاوية، عن الأعمش، ح وحدثنا زهير بن حرب، حدثنا جرير، عن منصور، جميعا عن إبراهيم، عن الأسود، عن عائشة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.quote: نحو حديث الحكم غير أنهما لا يذكران كئيبة حزينة

note: The single chain runs from al-Bukhari through Ibrahim b. Musa, Hisham, Ibn Jurayj, Amr b. Dinar, and Ata b. Mina to Abu Hurayra.

reasons.quote: حدثنا يحيى بن أيوب، وقتيبة، وابن، حجر قالوا حدثنا إسماعيل، - وهو ابن جعفر - عن العلاء، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

note: The single chain runs from al-Mufid through ten links, with the second occurrence of Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn followed by his father and his grandfather, ending before the Prophet.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from al-Mufid through ten links, with the second occurrence of Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn followed by his father and his grandfather, ending before the Prophet.

note: Two tahwil branches meet at Shu'ba via the dual verb and share the remaining tail through al-Miqdam Abi Karima.

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches meet at Shu'ba via the dual verb and share the remaining tail through al-Miqdam Abi Karima.

note: Two tahwil branches—the first through Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba and Abd Allah b. Idris, the second through co-transmitters Ishaq b. Ibrahim and Muhammad b. Rafi' via Abd al-Razzaq—converge at Ibn Jurayj.

reasons.claim: The chain is linear through six transmitters with two distinct links named Yahya separated by al-Awza'i, excluding the parenthetical gloss on the first Yahya.

reasons.quote: قال: حدثني أبي علي بن الحسين (عليهما السلام)

reasons.claim: The chain runs cleanly through seven narrators from Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba down to Safiyya bint Shayba and Aisha.

reasons.claim: The chain passes from Muhammad b. Kathir to Sufyan, then through an unnamed man to a second Sufyan, then Ubayd al-Sayd to al-Hasan.

reasons.claim: Two pairs of co-transmitters produce four routes meeting through Ja'far b. Awn, Abu Umays, and Abu Sakhra, with kunya-comma-name kept as one link.

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters meet at Abd Allah b. Idris, producing four routes down to Ya'la b. Umayya.

reasons.claim: The chain runs from Ishaq b. Ibrahim through Jarir, Mansur, and Abu Wa'il to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, with kunya-comma-name as one link.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Ibrahim b. Ya'qub through Zayd b. Hubab, Humayd al-Makki, and Ata b. Abi Rabah to Abu Hurayra, omitting the client description and the Prophet.
